name: Riso Print Editorial
description: Risograph duplicator print aesthetic: grainy soy-ink texture, two-color overlay with visible misregistration, and coarse halftone shading on warm paper white.
magic_media_keywords: Grainy risograph print texture with visible ink misregistration, flat two-color soy ink overlay in fluorescent pink and teal, coarse halftone dot shading, warm paper-white show-through, playful editorial zine illustration register, generous unprinted paper negative space reserved for typography.
palette_hint: classic riso ink duo — fluorescent pink (#FF48B0) and teal (#0078BF) on warm paper white (#FAF6EE), anchored by deep ink black (#1A1A1A) for legible contrast
best_for: zine covers, indie magazine spreads, and campus event flyers with tactile soy-ink texture
